binding_controls.evidence: The review must consult Iraq, Kuwait and civil society.
The review must consult Iraq and UN agencies. Kuwait supported the extension.
The review must consult Iraq and civil society, excluding Kuwait.
The review must seek the views of Iraq, Kuwait and civil society.
The Secretary-General was asked to conduct the independent strategic review and submit it to the Council by 31 March 2024.
The Council was asked to conduct the independent strategic review and submit it to the Secretary-General by 31 March 2024.
The Secretary-General was asked to conduct the independent strategic review and submit it to Iraq by 31 March 2024.
The review was to assess relevance and make recommendations regarding the mandate, structure and staffing.
The review will assess the relevance of the mandate and its staffing.
If the scope were broader, the review would assess relevance and make recommendations on the mandate.

scope: Posthoc requirements for three observed false-credit modes. A missing proof form refers a case for review. The authored controls include expected failures and do not certify entailment.
